name: Individual Ideal BMI
definition: The BMI that an individual perceives as ideal for themselves.

name: Physical Activity Level
definition: A factor representing the ratio of TDEE to BMR, indicating the level of physical activity.

name: Norm BMI
definition: The median BMI within a sociocultural group, reflecting the group's perception of a "normal" body weight

name: Basal Metabolic Rate
definition: The rate at which the body expends energy at rest to maintain vital functions

name: Healthy BMI
definition: A benchmark BMI value considered healthy, set at 22.5 kg/m² in the mode

name: Socio-cultural Ideal BMI
definition: The BMI value culturally regarded as ideal within a specific group.

name: Total Daily Energy Intake (TDEI)
definition: The total amount of energy consumed daily through food and beverages

name: Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE)
definition: The total amount of energy expended daily, encompassing basal metabolic rate and physical activity

name: Body Mass Index (BMI)
definition: Calculated from weight and height, representing an individual's body fat based on weight in relation to height
